study type: Retrospective analysis of prospectively collected data
outcome: Unplanned obstetrical intervention (UOI) due to labor dystocia
finding: Antepartum clinical assessment of the BTD might be used as a reliable predictor of UOI due to labor dystocia in low-risk, nulliparous women at term gestation.
mod_finding: The study found that a shorter Bituberous Diameter (BTD) was associated with unplanned obstetrical interventions (UOIs) due to labor dystocia, including both operative vaginal deliveries and cesarean sections.
